## 9296fec26a94

**Reproduced defect: an exact legal count override can underfill while `self_check` accepts it.** The source-bound generator SHA-256 is `f26d313356f9a07e8fcd695f590e247e79893602b40d86c6412c29a993e12986`; rule hash is `9f6888cf24e7`. For `difficulty="easy"`, override `block_count=3`, seed/sample indices `0..999`, exactly one draw underfilled: seed/sample `240` contained only two target windows. The target validator returned no errors, and the Racket output was successfully produced. The input belongs to the documented generator domain. Full grid, output, observed windows, hashes, and command are in `checks/audits/9296fec26a94_block_count_underfill.json`.

Additional contract checks found all four declared helpful textures byte-identical to default for 60/60 draws each, accepted an unknown override key, and rejected declared `grid_h=4` in the easy band. The official `lint`, `defect_lint`, and `override` stages all failed and are retained under `checks/audits/9296fec26a94_*`; the override report recorded more than 9,000 findings and 86,520 undeclared multi-axis rejections. No source was changed.

triage.reason: Both audit reports retained against exact target hashes; census results remain reviewer-reported. Repair targets are not modified by audits. Findings are visible to future assignments via task indexes.
